summary: Audited EuroComply main and PR #818 for build status, security risks, broken routes, configuration drift, billing/demo exposure, cron limits, and recent auth/onboarding changes. Its head had CI, Security CI, Full Security Suite, CodeQL, Semgrep, Gitleaks, Dependency Review, Actionlint, Upload Security CI, P0 Runtime Evidence, P0 Runtime Gap Report, P0 Progress, and Secret Scanning passing. Resolved an outdated review thread and merged PR #818. Production remains no-go until the post-merge main commit receives successful GitHub Actions validation.
